name: stateful-button
title: Stateful Button
blurb: Button toggles between states with animated icons.
description: A button that toggles between active/inactive states, animating icon transitions. Uses Framer Motion for entrance/exit animations.
use_when: You need a toggle button that clearly shows its current state.
avoid_when: When a simple checkbox or toggle switch is more appropriate.
a11y: Standard button; state changes should have aria-pressed or similar attributes for accessibility.
